about: Hash-bound identities and provenance for the V4.1 Flash M3 Ultra release. docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md states results and names no commit or date; this file and bench/RELEASE-EVIDENCE-V41.md say where every one of them came from.

upstream.note: stock upstream, clean-rebuilt for the release matrix

release.note: the build behind the kernel matrix, the TTFT arms and the memory measurements. Every arm on it named its levers explicitly rather than relying on a default.

depth_defaults.note: the selection-chain defaults as shipped: the compact index scorer and the bounded radix top-k selector on. The build behind the depth rows of docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md, and behind their control arm with both mechanisms off.

release_head.note: the build behind the first admission and sampled-decode sweeps and the first Spec-Bench run: the five MTP decode levers as defaults, the ported windowed admission controller before confidence admission, exact speculative sampling at temperature above zero, and --default-top-p / --default-min-p.

admission_screen.note: the build behind every DSpark number in docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md: confidence admission in, declines priced inside the three-call window. The fixture screen, the release gates, the held-out real-agent screen and the shipped Spec-Bench run are all this binary, one boot each.

production_head.note: the release head. Ten commits past f9dc5f9: two that make a long prefill leave continuable checkpoints behind (0f0a367, 9402d39), three that complete the admission port with GLM's confidence gate and drafter fault latch (35ed0f0, afe84d1, f1ba77e), and five that port the GLM-5.3-Flash branch's disk-KV eviction ladder with two test corrections and a store-layer reproducer (e26d830, bdbe6cf, 16e979b, e389ddd, 03eb931). The tree of this manifest's branch is this commit's tree plus documentation, reproducers and comment wording; the comment-stripped hash of every source file the branch touches is identical to this commit's.

depth_sweep.caveat_131k_300k: the 131k and 300k prefix repeats its content, so any acceptance-dependent figure at those depths is a property of that fixture rather than of depth. Serial decode is corpus-insensitive - a 0.4 % spread across corpora on both binaries - and stands at every depth.

depth_attribution.instrument: paged kernel ledger, mode 2, BY_TG, 192 pages, dumped after the decode loop; every arm certified 100.000 % coverage, complete=YES
depth_attribution.flat_families: flash attention 1.813 -> 1.810 ms/token, gather+KV stage, routed GU/down, shared+Q8 projections, HC/norm, Engram — all within 1 % across a 36x context range

admission.about: the shipped windowed cost-feedback admission controller with confidence admission. docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md sections 2 (Why it is useful), 3 (How to use it) and 5 (Evidence).
admission.design_origin: ds4_ds41_dspark_adaptive.h is a port of ds4_dflash_adaptive.h from this project's GLM-5.3-Flash / DFlash2 branch. The width search and the ACK guard are not ported: V4.1 verifies one trained block width, and its step commits inside itself so the guard could never fire.
admission.policy: propose the full trained block at every eligible greedy position; admit the longest run from the anchor at or above p_min and decline a run shorter than min_draft without verifying; 16-token serial entry wait; a window is three chosen calls, declines included, judged against the median of the last nine measured serial tokens; a losing window backs off 16, 32, 64 then 128 consumed serial tokens; reasoning spans decode serially and leaving one clears the cooldown

held_out_agent_screen.about: 226 archived agent sessions, every real assistant turn reconstructed as the request that produced it, 32 drawn at random with a fixed seed and held out; 14 measurable within the screen's cost cap, 6.7k-107k rendered tokens, 3 arms each, 4,096-token cap with natural EOS, phases separated on the stream
held_out_agent_screen.understates: the cost cap excluded the long draws, where the controller does best; nine further draws exceeded a 393,216-token context and were not measurable

standing_gates.about: restore-only through /debug/bench on the shipped controller's boot, every one byte-identical to its upstream bd66c40 reference

agent2_8k.note: the held-out real agent transcript a fixed block used to lose 19 % on

depth_mix_300k.note: the 24-token DSpark arms on this prefix price the 16-token serial entry wait rather than the controller and are not quoted

confidence_gate.about: GLM's dflash_adaptive_prefix, ported. docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md section 3, How admission decides.
confidence_gate.signal: normalised top probability of the post-Markov proposal row, already on the host after the Markov pass

p_min.note: GLM's value verbatim; not fitted on V4.1 traffic

min_draft.note: GLM declines below 4 of its 7 draft positions (0.57); V4.1 has 5, so 3 of 5 (0.60) carries it across

confidence_gate.decline_accounting: a decline takes a window slot at its drafter cost and three of them close a losing window; losing_cycles counts verified calls only
confidence_gate.decline_pricing_metric: controller over serial, one boot, on the nine DFlash fixtures of the branch this was ported from; 218 declines become 18 on prose
confidence_gate.identity: 8k code, 8k sql and the 8k agent fixture identical to the bd66c40 references across serial, fixed six and the controller; all ten content fixtures byte-identical across their three arms

kv_eviction.about: Disk-KV eviction: a decaying score baseline, store-time waypoint-ladder retention and deepest-first shedding under pressure. docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md section 3, The disk KV store. Disk-cache-only: it decides which KV snapshots survive, never what decode computes from one.
kv_eviction.design_origin: ported from this project's GLM-5.3-Flash branch (three eviction commits). Design credit is that branch's; the port, the store-layer reproducer and the two test corrections are this branch's, and the corrections are owed back.

DS4_KVSTORE_BASE_HALF_LIFE_SECONDS.what: half-life of the eviction score's baseline term; floored at 1e-6 so relative factors stay meaningful

KV_CACHE_LADDER_DENSE_WINDOW.what: compile-time: every rung within this many tokens of the frontier is kept

ladder_ratio.what: compile-time: each deeper kept rung sits at or below this fraction of the previous kept depth

motivating_numbers.note: an un-thinned 300k-token chain stores about 67 GiB of full-prefix snapshots at about 6.3 KB per token; under a 98,304 MB budget the pre-ladder policy let one conversation evict its own shallow waypoints and compaction then re-prefilled from token zero

ladder_budget.note: the ported test asserted a bound of under 3x the frontier, which the three dense rungs alone violate; corrected to under 5x plus twice the kept total below the un-thinned total, checked against a standalone copy of ds4_kvstore_ladder_select

kv_eviction.reproducer: test_kv_ladder_survives_compaction_pressure in the ./ds4_test --server suite: no model, no GPU, real wall-clock timestamps
kv_eviction.decode_impact: none. The production 8k/512 and 32k/256 byte gates were re-run on the release head's build and passed

fidelity.sampled_decode: certified separately: determinism at a fixed seed, and a chi-square test over 200,000 draws driving the shipped ds41_accept_or_residual(). docs/V41_M3ULTRA.md section 4
fidelity.scope: a statement about the gates and fixtures that were run, under greedy decode. No claim is made about an unmeasured prompt, and none at temperature above zero
